note: Manual corrections to the automatic template grouping. Applied by tools/da/apply-template-regrouping.js to catalog/template-catalog.json and tools/importer/page-templates.full-catalog.json. Rules run in order; a URL matched by a rule is moved to that rule's template.

rules.reason: Trixeo resource documents share one layout in both languages (breadcrumb, title, short paragraphs, revision code) and have no product tab row. The 17 FR copies had been grouped with product pages because they render in a narrower column.

The products index is the same page in every locale: hero, therapy-area tabs, product card grid, contact banner. DE/EN/IT had been grouped with landing pages; FR became its own template only because its capture was unstyled (CSS failed to load).
Campaign home page in every locale: banner, section tabs, key visual, two teaser cards, questions band. FR had become a separate 'alt' template because of a narrower content column.
Campaign interior pages (about, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment) are identical across locales. FR/IT diagnosis and symptoms had been grouped with the home page.
Contact pages are a form (name, email, area of interest, enquiry), not a text document, so they need their own import and a form block.

Breast cancer is a therapy-area article like its sibling oncology pages (card grid, text and image sections), not a single-column document. Its build differs: no hero banner, a key-figures card row, and stacked large images.
